delta_exposure_per_area.confound_flag: PRE battery contains the startup relaxation transient ordered by battery position (trial 0 H=1.0406 -> steady ~1.062 within ~5 trials; whole-trial rates similar but slightly depressed in the first ~3 trials); condition order is fixed, so raw Y_pre for early-battery positions absorbs the transient -> raw deltas for early positions are inflated. Drop-first-pre-replicate sensitivity provided.

omission_vs_intact_per_position.coverage_note: all 12 conditions x 8 reps present in BOTH pre and post batteries -> full coverage per area and position

evidence_marks_legend.MEASURED: value read directly from an artifact (array element, ledger field, sealed hash, schedule literal in result.json)
evidence_marks_legend.DERIVED: computed from MEASURED values (mean over replicates, difference, ratio, fit parameter, classification against a MODEL_ASSUMPTION threshold)
evidence_marks_legend.MODEL_ASSUMPTION: frozen design value (thresholds, bounds, tau_eff, schedule constants) taken from the design manifest / executor
evidence_marks_legend.INFERENCE: conclusion drawn from MEASURED evidence or deterministic source-code reading
evidence_marks_legend.UNRESOLVED: cannot be decided from the recorded evidence (no imputation applied)
